_comment: run_29 = run_25 (block-3 settlement) + SUB-CELL URBANISATION STRATA (population_model.subcell_strata): each 27 km cell is split into 6 within-cell built-up-intensity slices (HISDAC-US BUI quantiles, CONUS only; subcell_strata.npz), the cell's birds are redistributed among them each year by the fitness ideal-free rule, and the Allee factor and Beverton-Holt act per slice on LOCAL density. Mean-preserving tilts of K (subcell_beta_k ~ N(0,1)) and Fmax (subcell_delta_f ~ N(0,0.5)) per sd of log BUI; both 0 = run_25.

Why (user, 2026-10-16): coarse dispersal + ideal rearrangement among fine pixels; early colonists cluster in towns, bypassing the cell-mean Allee effect -- at the release AND along the front. Targets the strong Allee, the sparse-cell exodus and lambda0 ~2 together (research/age_model E017).
